subject: Re: conference trip
text:
Following your note, as your neighbor, I can still share the ride to the airport at 6:15. If the hotel confirmation portal stays glitchy, just send me the PDF instead. I don't need the booking code, only the pickup time and lobby floor. My phone kept rejecting the password earlier, so I didn't edit your seat preference. I'll handle the shuttle request tomorrow morning. Let me know if the revised itinerary changes before then.

Best,
Elias
